I've actually done a lot of work on it, and as it stands, I think it works pretty well, but I've never shared it. Perhaps I'll throw it up on Github one day. I was also seriously considering, and had played around with making a web-based interface (using Bottle, which has very similar functionality to Flask), but is only one relatively small file), with the idea that eventually I could set up a game on a server somewhere, with some sort of user account system, and people could create an account and play.
